findings.reason: The real service fixture starts with allowed mtime 10000 and excluded mtimes 30000. Excluded real-source edits become 40000 and excluded metadata becomes a landscape at 50000. After resetting only the check throttle, the actual cached SkillLandscape remains the identical object and both scanner/watermark stay 10000. This checks cache behavior and an observable accepted update, not just a helper-return assertion.
